browser-workflow.known_good: An uncertain save is reconciled from a persisted read view without losing the draft or submitting twice; protected fields remain unchanged.
browser-workflow.known_fail: A stale page or zero-exit framework script is treated as success, or a blocked target is retried through another CLI.

agent-compatibility.known_good: A fresh clone documents one command, tracks every required fixture, and recovers a stale job from a receipt.
agent-compatibility.known_fail: Startup depends on an ignored local file and an archived PID, or a missing question tool forces installation of a new service.

architecture-survey.known_good: A bounded caller-and-test trace proves three consumers duplicate the same state transition.
architecture-survey.known_fail: A large file alone triggers a whole-workspace scan and an unselected refactor.

cli-contract-review.known_good: Preflight is side-effect free and the command emits distinct setup-failure and product-failure receipts.
cli-contract-review.known_fail: A missing output path opens a prompt after partial writes, or truncated output is mistaken for bounded traversal.

verify-claim.known_good: Baseline and treatment use the same input, checker, environment, and explicit threshold.
verify-claim.known_fail: A source unit test proves an installed CLI claim, or an incomplete export is used to deny an earlier user-observed event.

intent-checkpoint.known_good: A consequential unselected protection proposal becomes a short scope question; an explicit bounded choice proceeds without repeat approval.
intent-checkpoint.known_fail: An old test-signing note becomes a release requirement, or an unanswered preselected option is recorded as user consent.

grok-bridge.known_good: One ready synthetic child/turn/parent binding, one finite observer, same-handle continuation and actual native receipt at the parent.
grok-bridge.known_fail: A returned ID or catalog file is treated as readiness/runtime proof, or a yielded collector is aborted and mislabeled timeout.
